UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Stores public information about a user.

messageCount.description: The number of messages sent by the user today.

lastMessageDate.description: The date of the last message sent by the user, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

apiKey.description: The user's API key for the provider.

nickname.description: A custom nickname for this configuration.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the user profile was created.

ChatSession.title: Chat Session
ChatSession.description: Metadata for a single chat session between a user and the AI.

title.description: The title of the chat session, often derived from the first message.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the chat was created.

userId.description: The ID of the user who owns this chat.

ChatMessage.title: Chat Message
ChatMessage.description: A single message within a chat session.

content.description: The text content of the message.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the message was sent.

SubscriptionRequest.title: Subscription Request
SubscriptionRequest.description: Stores a user's manual payment submission for a subscription upgrade.

userId.description: The ID of the user requesting the subscription.

requestedPlan.description: The plan the user is requesting.

planPrice.description: The price of the requested plan.

paymentPhoneNumber.description: The phone number from which the payment was sent.

transactionId.description: The transaction ID of the payment.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the request was created.

adminNotes.description: Notes from the admin who reviewed the request.

/users/{userId}/chats/{chatId}.description: Stores metadata for a user's chat sessions.

/users/{userId}/chats/{chatId}/messages/.description: Stores all messages for a specific chat session.

/subscription_requests/{requestId}.description: Stores user subscription requests for manual admin verification.
